sentences.en: What did the businessman say when he invented the zip-fastener?
sentences.zh: 这位商人发明了拉链后说了什么？

sentences.en: A businessman is working out some figures with a calculator.
sentences.zh: 一位商人在用计算器计算一些数字。

sentences.en: "Define your terms," requested the businessman at the contract hearings.
sentences.zh: 在合同听证会上，那位商人要求‘请定义你们的条款’。

senses.zh: 商人；实业家，从事工商业的人具有经营者所必需素质的人，生财有道者
